articles.title: The Diplomat Season 5: Netflix Renewal Status & What To Expect
articles.summary: The fourth season of the Netflix series 'The Diplomat' is currently streaming, concluding with a significant narrative shift. Viewers who have completed all eight episodes are keenly awaiting news regarding the show's renewal status from Netflix. The article discusses the potential for future seasons and the impact of the latest finale.

articles.title: Indian Navy inducts indigenous multi-purpose warship Samarthak
articles.summary: India's first multi-purpose vessel, 'Samarthak,' built by a private shipyard, has been commissioned into the Navy. This marks a significant milestone, showcasing the expanding capabilities of the domestic industry in warship construction and support. The induction strengthens India's self-reliance in defence manufacturing, enhancing naval operational readiness and promoting 'Make in India' initiatives within the defence sector.

articles.title: ‘The Mandalorian and Grogu’ VFX Veteran Hal Hickel on Rotta’s Redesign, Phil Tippett and Jon Favreau’s ‘Less James Bond, More Jackass’ Approach
articles.summary: Industrial Light & Magic animation supervisor Hal Hickel is employing a unique creative strategy for Jon Favreau’s “The Mandalorian and Grogu.” His approach involves asking, “What would Phil do?”, referencing an influential figure to guide animation decisions. This method emphasizes drawing inspiration from established expertise to shape the visual narrative and animation quality for the highly anticipated Star Wars project.

articles.title: Drone strikes in Black Sea raise fears of Russian escalation
articles.summary: Romanian warships recently conducted a naval exercise near Constanta, Romania, in April 2024. This drill took place amidst escalating maritime threats, including a string of drone attacks targeting at least seven cargo ships. Such incidents underscore the critical importance of naval forces in ensuring security for international shipping lanes and regional stability.

articles.title: Indian Navy inducts multi-purpose INS Samarthak, a drone mothership and weapons testbed, the first major warship built by a private shipyard
articles.summary: The Indian Navy recently commissioned 'Samarthak', its first multi-purpose vessel constructed by a private shipyard, at Karwar, Karnataka. This event marks a significant stride in India's 'Aatmanirbhar Bharat' and 'Make in India' initiatives for defence manufacturing. The vessel enhances naval capabilities and underscores the growing role of private industry in strengthening national security, demonstrating indigenous prowess.

articles.title: Gold rate today (October 16, 2026): Check 24k, 22k, 20k, 18k gold jewellery prices from IBJA, Malabar Gold & Diamonds, Joyalukkas, Kalyan Jewellers and Tanishq
articles.summary: On Friday, October 16, 2026, gold jewellery prices at major retail brands in India held steady. Conversely, the India Bullion and Jewellers Association reported higher indicative prices for both gold and silver jewellery. This indicates a divergence between immediate retail stability and an upward movement in wholesale or benchmark rates within the Indian bullion market.
